items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Linda is mentioned by the interviewer as one of Danny Barker's children ('Larry, Kelly and Christopher and Linda'), but Danny Barker does not speak about her or interact with her in the transcript.

ctx.x: And (?) and two wedding rings on the fifty years of marriage...

"From January 8, 1930 to..." Oh, isn't this beautiful, still here. "Larry, Kelly and Christopher and Linda." Isn't that beautiful? This is just lovely. Well, congratulations. And I hope we can just go right on into that century mark together! [LAUGHS] I laugh at these young people and what they do.
What are you into now, Danny? What are you doing now? -- just to wind this up.
